_comment: db-pro project config for tools/cc-scan.py (truongnat/clean-code-skills). MAGIC_NUMBER is skipped for the same reason the pack skips it itself: it fires inside `const` declarations (already the named constant) and all over egui painting geometry. DEBUG_STATEMENT is covered by the repo's own grep scan (.skills/clean-code/scripts/clean-code-scan.sh) which blocks eprintln!/dbg!/println! outside tests. minTestRatio=0 because Rust keeps tests in inline #[cfg(test)] modules, not separate files.
